meta.title: 1962 Canadian BCP, Daily Office lessons, full ecclesiastical year
meta.description: The Table of Lessons of the 1962 Book of Common Prayer of the Anglican Church of Canada, Advent through the Sunday next before Advent. Transcribed from the official ACC PDF under the plan curation process.

sources.ref: The Book of Common Prayer (1962), General Synod of the Anglican Church of Canada, The Table of Lessons, pages xv to xxiii
sources.note: Downloaded 2026-11-18 to /tmp/opencode/bcp1962-acc.pdf. PDF metadata: Title 'The Book of Common Prayer (1962, Canada)', Author 'The General Synod of the Anglican Church of Canada', 792 pages, 2.7 MB. Text extracted with pdftotext -layout.

sources.ref: Lectionary Central, The Table of Daily Lessons from The Book of Common Prayer Canada 1962
sources.note: Third-party presentation with unclear extraction rights. Used only to flag discrepancies against the primary witness, never as the transcription base.

caveats: Curation slice only: Advent through Epiphany VI. The rest of the ecclesiastical year is not yet curated.
Citations are transcribed verbatim from the witness, including chapter-only references, the word 'end', parenthetical alternatives, and the witness's book abbreviations.
A null first or second slot means the witness printed a dash.
Four cross-check deviations were resolved against page images and kept as printed. See PROVENANCE.md.
Section ids and day keys are editorial join keys. The witness organizes the table by Sunday headings and weekday initials.

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.note: QA flag 1 resolved by page image: 'Isa. 5. 18–end' is the printed reading. The cross-check's 5:18-30 is a deviation, not adopted.

saturday.label: Saturday
saturday.note: The witness prints dashes for both evening lessons on this day.

christmas-eve.label: Christmas Eve
christmas-eve.note: The witness prints dashes for both morning lessons.

sunday-after-christmas.label: Sunday after Christmas Day
sunday-after-christmas.note: The witness appoints these lessons for Years I & II together, and notes that they are read only when 29, 30, or 31 December is a Sunday.

december-29.label: December 29
december-29.note: QA flag 4 resolved by page image: 'Ruth 1. 1–8' is printed. The cross-check's 1:1-18 is a deviation, not adopted.

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.note: The witness appoints these lessons for Years I & II together, and notes that they are read only when 2, 3, 4, or 5 January is a Sunday, and in the last case the Morning Lessons only.

sections.label: Epiphany and the weekdays before the First Sunday after Epiphany

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.note: QA flag 2 resolved by page image: 'Matt. 17. 31–13' is printed, likely a printing error for 17. 1–13. Kept verbatim.

tuesday.label: Tuesday
tuesday.note: QA flag 3 resolved by page image: 'Acts 23—23. 11' is printed, likely missing '22.'. Kept verbatim.

saturday.label: Saturday
saturday.note: Only the morning first lesson is divided by year; the witness gives one set for the other slots.

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.note: The witness appoints the same morning lessons for both years.

easter-day.label: Easter Day
easter-day.note: The witness prints 'Rev. 1. 4. 18', likely for Rev. 1:4–18. Kept verbatim.

sections.label: Trinity Sunday and the week following

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.note: Printed oddity: 'Acts 13. 31–13 (14–26)' in the Year I morning second slot of the witness text. Kept verbatim pending a page-image check.

monday.label: Monday
monday.note: Printed oddity: 'Luke 2. 31–21' in the witness. Kept verbatim.

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.note: Printed oddity: '1 Pet. 2. 31–17' in the Year I morning second slot. Kept verbatim.

sections.label: Sunday next before Advent and the week following

alternativeFirstLessons.note: The witness appoints these First Lessons as alternatives, at the discretion of the Minister, in place of the Lessons from the Apocrypha on Sundays from the twenty-first to the twenty-sixth after Trinity. They replace only the first lessons; the second lessons are unchanged.
